purpose: Single runtime entry point for MathBridge content assembly.
runtime_sequence: Resolve Chinese selected grade to verified current textbook placement if available, otherwise national learning stage.
Resolve England or Common Core progression independently.
Load stored comparison copy in selected language.
Resolve evidence locators and status labels.
hard_rules: Use England for the statutory National Curriculum in England.
Common Core is a US baseline, not one nationwide US curriculum.
Do not infer same-numbered grade equivalence.
Do not use legacy PEP as current.
Do not state unverified current PEP semester placement as fact.
Do not infer national classroom practice frequency from curriculum or guidance.
One wrong answer is not a diagnosis.
Teacher-facing copy is direct, educational and non-promotional.
